epic.title: ADE Operations Platform
epic.description: Governed agentic data-engineering operations: a supervisor of risk-tiered skills turning platform telemetry into safe, approved, reversible improvements to freshness, cost, quality, and trust. Read-only first; execution approval-gated. Built on durable primitives, independent of the deletable ADE connector surface.

features.title: PR 1 — Skeleton + 5 read-only commands
features.description: Read-only governed skeleton: risk tiers 0-5, supervisor-of-skills, OpsSkillDef registry, immutable receipts on ai_decision_audit_log, /api/ade/ops, console, fail-closed honesty. Tier >=2 visible but non-executable. The 5 commands: scan pipelines, assess freshness, show cost hotspots, recommend rightsize, can I trust this number.
